title_zh: 三核两翼八要素创新生态运营图谱
title_en: Three-Core, Two-Wing, Eight-Element Innovation Ecosystem Operating Map
authority_boundary_zh: 本图谱仅定义候选功能接口和证据接续，不任命机构，不确认合作、资金、场地、数据共享、采购或投资安排。外部区域均为候选输入输出接口，须另行取得参与意愿、授权与适用合规意见。
authority_boundary_en: This map defines candidate functional interfaces and evidence handoffs only. It appoints no organisation and confirms no partnership, funding, site, data sharing, procurement, or investment arrangement. Every external area is a candidate input-output interface subject to separate consent, authority, and applicable compliance review.

core_nodes.function_zh: 组织真实问题、普通服务基线、人才与专业服务接口，并形成进入或不进入PoC的证据。
core_nodes.function_en: Organises real problems, ordinary-service baselines, talent and professional-service interfaces, and evidence to enter or not enter PoC.

core_nodes.function_zh: 开展版本复现、端侧能耗、具身安全、人工接管和独立复核，形成通过、限用、整改或停止结论。
core_nodes.function_en: Conducts version reproduction, edge-energy, embodied-safety, human-takeover, and independent review, producing pass, restricted-use, corrective-action, or stop findings.

core_nodes.function_zh: 衔接真实需求、独立验证、市场调研、依法采购、限定部署、90/180日评价与退出。
core_nodes.function_en: Connects real demand, independent validation, market research, lawful procurement, bounded deployment, 90/180-day evaluation, and exit.

support_wings.interface_zh: 为三核提供候选的知识产权、技术转移、人才、财务法务、创业服务与市场信息输入；任何服务主体须依法确定。
support_wings.interface_en: Provides candidate intellectual-property, technology-transfer, talent, finance-legal, entrepreneurship, and market-information inputs to the three cores; every service provider remains subject to lawful appointment.

support_wings.interface_zh: 为公共服务、社区、滨水和开放空间问题提供候选场景与用户反馈，并将验证结果返回实际服务评价；不表示场地已开放。
support_wings.interface_en: Provides candidate public-service, community, waterfront, and open-space problems and user feedback, and returns validation results to actual-service evaluation; it does not confirm that any site is open.

core_roles.CORE-AI-ORIGIN: 共享首层候选权利与开放时段核验
core_roles.CORE-ZHONGZHIYUAN: 测试场地权利、保险和安全边界核验
core_roles.CORE-DAZHONGSI: 站前及服务空间候选权利与采购权限核验

elements.required_artifact_zh: 场地权利、用途、开放条件与禁止事项核验单
elements.required_artifact_en: Site rights, use, access conditions, and prohibitions verification record
elements.no_commitment_zh: 不据临时工作窗确定宗地、拆改留或土地供应。
elements.no_commitment_en: Provisional work windows determine no parcel, retention-demolition decision, or land supply.

core_roles.CORE-AI-ORIGIN: 需求协同、人工服务与安静交流界面
core_roles.CORE-ZHONGZHIYUAN: 公众观察、受控测试和设备后勤分区
core_roles.CORE-DAZHONGSI: 站外到达、需求合规与转化服务界面

elements.required_artifact_zh: 现状核查、无障碍路径、消防疏散和可逆组件图
elements.required_artifact_en: Baseline survey, accessible route, fire-egress, and reversible-component plan
elements.no_commitment_zh: 不形成工程线位、建筑轮廓或永久构筑物结论。
elements.no_commitment_en: Creates no engineering alignment, building footprint, or permanent-structure conclusion.

core_roles.CORE-AI-ORIGIN: 形成真实问题与需求责任
core_roles.CORE-ZHONGZHIYUAN: 将需求转为可复现测试任务
core_roles.CORE-DAZHONGSI: 连接多个可比较方案与应用单位

elements.required_artifact_zh: 需求简报、应用责任、非AI基线和暂不转化理由
elements.required_artifact_en: Demand brief, application accountability, non-AI baseline, and reason not to convert
elements.no_commitment_zh: 不编造企业名单、产值、招商或采购结果。
elements.no_commitment_en: Invents no company list, output value, investment promotion, or procurement result.

elements.title_zh: 资金与全生命周期成本

core_roles.CORE-AI-ORIGIN: 记录需求形成、公众参与和人工服务成本类别
core_roles.CORE-ZHONGZHIYUAN: 记录测试、独立验证、保险和安全成本类别
core_roles.CORE-DAZHONGSI: 汇总市场取价、预算状态、运维和退出成本证据

elements.required_artifact_zh: 工程量、价格样本、预算、合同、维护和退出取证表
elements.required_artifact_en: Quantity, price-sample, budget, contract, maintenance, and exit evidence register
elements.no_commitment_zh: 未经核验的金额、资金来源或比例不计入确定性总额。
elements.no_commitment_en: Unverified amounts, funding sources, or ratios remain outside any firm total.

core_roles.CORE-AI-ORIGIN: 共同定义问题与辅导可拒绝的PoC
core_roles.CORE-ZHONGZHIYUAN: 训练复现、红队和安全接管能力
core_roles.CORE-DAZHONGSI: 训练需求解释、合规、运维和后评估能力

elements.required_artifact_zh: 参与章程、贡献记录、培训记录、利益冲突和转化路径
elements.required_artifact_en: Participation charter, contribution record, training record, conflict disclosure, and conversion pathway
elements.no_commitment_zh: 参与不构成就业、投资、采购或落户承诺。
elements.no_commitment_en: Participation creates no employment, investment, procurement, or settlement commitment.

core_roles.CORE-AI-ORIGIN: 提出最小技术需求并保留非AI渠道
core_roles.CORE-ZHONGZHIYUAN: 记录版本、能耗、设备、断网和急停
core_roles.CORE-DAZHONGSI: 核算部署、维护、更新、迁移和退出条件

elements.required_artifact_zh: 版本清单、设备与能耗日志、维护班次、人工接管和迁移退出计划
elements.required_artifact_en: Version inventory, equipment and energy logs, maintenance shifts, human takeover, and migration-exit plan
elements.no_commitment_zh: 不预设算力容量、设备品牌、供应商或全面部署能力。
elements.no_commitment_en: Predetermines no compute capacity, equipment brand, supplier, or full-deployment capability.

core_roles.CORE-AI-ORIGIN: 确认最小必要数据和公开知识边界
core_roles.CORE-ZHONGZHIYUAN: 使用合法或合成数据开展隔离测试
core_roles.CORE-DAZHONGSI: 按合同和公共利益复核使用、申诉、删除与审计

elements.required_artifact_zh: 来源许可、处理目的、访问控制、保存期限、删除证明和公开范围
elements.required_artifact_en: Provenance and licence, processing purpose, access control, retention period, deletion proof, and publication scope
elements.no_commitment_zh: 不使用非公开政府数据、个人隐私或无授权企业数据作为必要条件。
elements.no_commitment_en: Uses no non-public government, personal, or unauthorised enterprise data as a prerequisite.

core_roles.CORE-AI-ORIGIN: 将公共问题转为带人工和普通服务保障的场景
core_roles.CORE-ZHONGZHIYUAN: 验证失败模式、人工接管和停止条件
core_roles.CORE-DAZHONGSI: 评价真实使用、公共价值、持续成本与退出恢复

elements.required_artifact_zh: 场景契约、公众意见、实际使用、事件申诉、普通服务等价和退出回执
elements.required_artifact_en: Scenario contract, public input, actual use, incidents and appeals, ordinary-service equivalence, and exit receipt
elements.no_commitment_zh: 测试通过不等于采购、部署、安全或公共价值已经成立。
elements.no_commitment_en: Test passage does not establish procurement, deployment, safety, or public value.

external_candidate_interfaces.candidate_input_zh: 真实公共服务问题、普通服务基线和代表性用户意见
external_candidate_interfaces.candidate_input_en: Real public-service problem, ordinary-service baseline, and representative-user views
external_candidate_interfaces.candidate_output_zh: 无账号服务蓝图、无障碍核查与申诉退出模板
external_candidate_interfaces.candidate_output_en: No-account service blueprint, accessibility audit, and appeal/exit template
external_candidate_interfaces.activation_preconditions_zh: 属地、场地或物业、服务责任和参与授权依法明确
external_candidate_interfaces.activation_preconditions_en: Local, site or property, service-duty, and participation authority lawfully established

external_candidate_interfaces.candidate_input_zh: 可公开的研究问题、测试方法需求和知识许可边界
external_candidate_interfaces.candidate_input_en: Publishable research problem, testing-method need, and knowledge-licence boundary
external_candidate_interfaces.candidate_output_zh: 可复现测试任务、对照结论和限制清单
external_candidate_interfaces.candidate_output_en: Reproducible test assignment, comparative finding, and limitations register
external_candidate_interfaces.activation_preconditions_zh: 技术、数据、知识产权和发布责任经相关主体确认
external_candidate_interfaces.activation_preconditions_en: Technology, data, intellectual-property, and publication duties confirmed

external_candidate_interfaces.candidate_input_zh: 可转译的科学问题、设施接口需求和安全边界
external_candidate_interfaces.candidate_input_en: Translatable scientific problem, facility-interface need, and safety boundary
external_candidate_interfaces.candidate_output_zh: 场景问题简报、受控验证方法和可迁移知识摘要
external_candidate_interfaces.candidate_output_en: Scenario brief, controlled validation method, and portable knowledge summary
external_candidate_interfaces.activation_preconditions_zh: 设施、安全、保密、数据和成果使用权限依法核定
external_candidate_interfaces.activation_preconditions_en: Facility, safety, confidentiality, data, and result-use authority established

external_candidate_interfaces.candidate_input_zh: 真实应用单位需求、非 AI 基线和生产运行约束
external_candidate_interfaces.candidate_input_en: Real application-owner need, non-AI baseline, and production or operation constraints
external_candidate_interfaces.candidate_output_zh: 首用转化证据包、全生命周期成本和退出恢复方法
external_candidate_interfaces.candidate_output_en: First-use evidence pack, whole-life cost method, and exit or restoration method
external_candidate_interfaces.activation_preconditions_zh: 应用主体、场地、安全、采购和运维责任成立
external_candidate_interfaces.activation_preconditions_en: Application owner, site, safety, procurement, and operations duties established

external_candidate_interfaces.candidate_input_zh: 跨区域共性问题、适用标准和差异条件
external_candidate_interfaces.candidate_input_en: Cross-regional common problem, applicable standards, and local differences
external_candidate_interfaces.candidate_output_zh: 可复用问题或测试模板、双语失败案例和适用边界
external_candidate_interfaces.candidate_output_en: Reusable problem or test templates, bilingual failure cases, and applicability limits
external_candidate_interfaces.activation_preconditions_zh: 各地权责、标准、数据、知识产权和合作程序分别确认
external_candidate_interfaces.activation_preconditions_en: Each jurisdiction separately confirms authority, standards, data, intellectual property, and cooperation procedure

handoff_logic.artifact_zh: 核验后的需求简报、数据边界与普通服务基线
handoff_logic.artifact_en: Validated demand brief, data boundary, and ordinary-service baseline

handoff_logic.artifact_zh: 可复现测试包、独立意见与限制条件
handoff_logic.artifact_en: Reproducible test pack, independent finding, and restrictions

handoff_logic.artifact_zh: 实际使用、公众意见、失败与退出知识回流
handoff_logic.artifact_en: Feedback of actual use, public input, failure, and exit knowledge
